description: This file contains the PHP implementation of the ADOdb PostgreSQL 9+ driver, including class definitions that extend previous versions for database interaction.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres9
classes.description: Class representing the PostgreSQL 9 driver, extending the PostgreSQL 8 driver with a specified database type.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres9
classes.description: Class for PostgreSQL 9 record set, extending the PostgreSQL 8 record set with a specific database type.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_assoc_postgres9
classes.description: Class for associative PostgreSQL 9 record set, extending the PostgreSQL 8 associative record set with a specific database type.

methods.name: ADODB_postgres9 (constructor/initializer)
methods.description: Initializes the PostgreSQL 9 driver class, setting the database type.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_postgres9 (constructor/initializer)
methods.description: Initializes the PostgreSQL 9 record set class, setting the database type.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_assoc_postgres9 (constructor/initializer)
methods.description: Initializes the associative PostgreSQL 9 record set class, setting the database type.
